name: predicex
description: PREDICEX - Plataforma de Optimizacion de Suministro y Logistica Predictiva

scripts.db:init: node -e "require('./src/backend/load-env'); const { execFileSync } = require('node:child_process'); const server = process.env.SQL_SERVER || 'localhost'; execFileSync('sqlcmd', ['-S', server, '-E', '-i', 'src/database/sqlserver.sql'], { stdio: 'inherit' });"
